data.name: 少女的求生之路：研究所
data.detailed_description:
[Official production completed]

The content includes: day1+day2+day3+day5+day6+day7, a total of 6 major chapters.

The campus route and the exploration route conflict with each other, and it is impossible to complete all storyline collections if only playing once.

The style leans towards puzzle-solving and storytelling, allowing players to freely choose their preferred plot progression.

If I can bring a little bit of emotion to everyone, I will be satisfied QwQ

"A young girl's journey to survival: The Research Institute"

2D pixel art + transformable heroine + high-definition CG + super rich plot + multiple endings!

{Introduction to gameplay}

0. Exquisite CG includes 10+ pieces (including differential)

1. Day and night system: The time in-game flows naturally, and the map changes between day, dusk, and night. (Story events are affected by time)

2. Date system: Players will spend seven days in the research institute, during which they can move freely and are not restricted.

3. Life system: The protagonist has fatigue, hunger, and thirst levels, and needs to eat, drink, and sleep to maintain good health. If you don't pay attention to these, the game may end.

4. Plot branches: As a role-playing game, the game boasts a rich array of plot branches.

You will encounter numerous choices in the game, and each choice will trigger different events, even affecting the actions of related characters the next day.

It's no exaggeration to say that your choice holds the fate of the entire world in its hands.

Of course, there will be important characters who will either die or survive due to your choices, and their presence or absence will also affect subsequent events.

5. Multiple Endings: Rich in options, each ending is carefully crafted

{Here is the content introduction}

Shocked! A man who left home in the middle of the night was transported by a truck to a different world and turned into a fantastic pink haired beauty?!

~The peaceful daily life is over. What rushed to the battlefield immediately was the wonderful life of the super cute anime in the different world~

Happy and lively cat lady roommates, mysterious and dangerous twin ponytail girls, silent white haired little girls wandering around, and even distinguished ladies coming to inspect?!

But you understand that even the most beautiful life has an end, so you must find a way to {go home} within seven days.

This is a heartwarming and slightly mysterious story.

Unravel the truth during your seven days on campus!
